title: Using Early Readouts to Mediate Featural Bias in Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) on subgroups where gender is spuriously correlated with the target label, using the CelebA dataset (gender vs. hair color) and the CivilComments-WILDS dataset (gender identity mentions vs. toxicity).
Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) on toxicity classification for comments containing mentions of racial or ethnic identities (e.g., White, Black) in the CivilComments-WILDS dataset.
Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) on toxicity classification for comments containing mentions of religious affiliations (e.g., Muslim, Christian) in the CivilComments-WILDS dataset.
Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) on toxicity classification for comments containing mentions of LGBTQ identities in the CivilComments-WILDS dataset.

Evaluating Worst Group Accuracy (WGA) on instances where incidental, non-causal features (like image backgrounds in the Waterbirds dataset or syntactic negation words in the MultiNLI dataset) conflict with the true label to measure the model's reliance on spurious correlations.
